title: Self inner product equals expected square
statement:
For a Boolean function $f : \{0,1\}^n \to \bbr$, the $L^2$ inner product of $f$ with
itself equals the expectation of its square: $\langle f, f\rangle = \E[f^2]$, that is,
$2^{-n}\sum_{x \in \{0,1\}^n} f(x)^2$.
hypotheses_covered: f is a Boolean function of arity n
replaced:
The self inner product of a Boolean function equals the expectation of its square:
$\langle f, f \rangle = \E[f^2]$.
